ignorePatterns.reason: TypeScript 6.0.3's own test inputs from tests/cases/compiler with their upstream baselines and Node goldens (stage3/drivers/tsc/README.md): foreign code the diagnostics oracle feeds to tsc byte for byte, so cohere neither checks nor formats it, as with vendored code (Kirk's cohere-zero ask, Nov 24, #ybkwr91).

Lint-oracle adapters behind the lintoracle build tag: they import cohere's internal packages, so they compile and are checked only inside cohere's module with an overlay, by adamic's oracle tests (docs/lint-registration.md:80). No build of adamic's module can compile them.
